answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with costly continuity: each identity must keep a bonded stake that unlocks only after delayed peer scoring, so a flood of shells cannot cash out before panels judge. Treat that stake like a signal beacon of skin in the game; an opal of unique contribution history that peers can audit; and an echo of prior grades that clone farms cannot forge. Without matching scored history, new addresses stay ineligible for seats and emissions.
